object.body:
Hello $data.requesterName,

Your request to create the machine account $data.accountName on $data.sourceName was completed successfully.

The account is now active and ready for use. The account owner has been notified and can begin managing the account.


Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to a requester to notify that their machine account create request has been completed successfully.
object.name: Machine Account Creation Request Completed
object.subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request successfully completed for $data.accountName
